items.resolution: Deny-by-default GET-only HTTPS exact-host/path public-data boundary is bounded by timeout, response size and range, validates redirect targets before redirected I/O, and exposes no private/trading endpoint authority.

FINAL_HOLDOUT trials require one-use consumed final_validation permits bound one-to-one to a trial; CI statically forbids research imports/symbols that would create execution authority.

Holm evidence is computed over the complete frozen trial family; PBO/CSCV and Deflated Sharpe require explicit statistical preconditions and fail closed when the trial universe/evidence is incomplete.

An explicit opt-in 10-bar BTCUSDT public-data campaign performed two independent read-only fetches with equal source/dataset/manifest hashes and verified artifact roundtrip; no API keys, trading endpoints or execution authority were used. This is intake/reproducibility evidence, not profitability evidence.
Research Control Center is a read-only projection over immutable research evidence and remains outside OMS/broker/capital authority by construction and CI policy.

Strategy Tournament deterministically ranks the complete frozen DEVELOPMENT universe, includes failed trials, uses explicit metric direction and immutable identity tie-breaking, rejects HOLDOUT-containing campaigns/cherry-picked candidate sets, binds evidence to terminal result hashes and exposes no execution or promotion authority.

Versioned append-only authoritative venue-rule master is structurally separate from research metadata; canonical identities, tick/step/min-max rules, status, provenance, staleness and dual persisted/embedded fingerprint integrity are fail-closed and machine-contract validated.

Canonical correlation/dependence evidence uses one common aligned panel, deterministic recomputed clusters and exact strategy/cluster/portfolio budget validation; insufficient or forged evidence fails closed and the module has no execution authority.

Deterministic complete leave-one-out and bounded allocation perturbation evidence is recomputed from source inputs; non-positive/degenerate baselines, budget violations and fragile allocations fail closed.

Regime calibration structurally permits TRAIN/DEVELOPMENT only; FINAL_HOLDOUT evaluates frozen models only. Missing/stale/future features are UNKNOWN and the append-only registry verifies durable lineage, row identity and parser integrity before advancing versions.

Durable Strategy/Portfolio Health & Drift uses immutable baseline/policy binding, separate entity namespaces, hash-verified state, monotone automatic worsening, non-consecutive replay idempotency and explicit fresh-evidence acknowledged recovery.

Durable Defensive Health Bridge reads authoritative health state and automatically maintains/tightens risk only. Strategy/portfolio stricter-state-wins, missing/stale fail-closed semantics, raw-row integrity, replay idempotency, safety-state version invalidation, submit-time OMS recheck and explicit fresh-evidence one-level recovery are certified. The bridge never increases exposure or bypasses Safety/OMS.

Deterministic Portfolio Manager emits advisory bounded capacity only. It recomputes base/post-Health/post-venue diversification and robustness, binds strategy identity to Health identity, requires fresh authoritative instrument rules and quotes, rounds quantity down, never upsizes to venue minima, and is protected by a permanent CI authority boundary forbidding OMS/broker/execution creep.

Existing R0/R2 versioned Portfolio State, reconciliation and reservation infrastructure was audited and hardened for R4: persistence and Safety share one semantic snapshot validator; in-memory stores detach nested mappings, validate CAS/reconciliation writes, and publish fill batches atomically; durable state integrity is covered by the companion R4 fill/portfolio commitments.

Every durable fill read/replay now verifies canonical payload against fill_hash plus independent fill_id/order_id/occurred_at columns; malformed, rehashed-conflicting or corrupted rows fail closed before OMS or portfolio projection can consume them.

portfolio_state now carries an independent SHA-256 commitment over exact canonical snapshot bytes; every read/write/CAS/reservation validates hash and shared semantic integrity, with conservative legacy migration that refuses to bless invalid prior rows.

Allocation robustness now preserves exact Decimal sum(weights)==1 for repeating ratios using deterministic canonical remainder normalization across baseline, leave-one-out and perturbation scenarios; the invariant was preserved rather than replaced with a tolerance.

Health and Defensive Health Bridge recovery acknowledgements now require durable recovery_id binding. Same-request retries are no-ops, conflicting reuse fails closed, and a duplicate bridge retry cannot relax twice, bump safety_state twice or append a second recovery ledger event.

items.area: Defensive Health Bridge authoritative-state synchronization gap
items.resolution: Every effective bridge read now overlays the current authoritative Health state. Missing/stale/future/backward/conflicting authoritative evidence fails closed, newer worsening tightens immediately before sync, and newer recovery evidence never relaxes the durable bridge without explicit recovery/synchronization. Safety and OMS inherit the overlay on every control read.

Health recovery acknowledgements are now an append-only per-entity hash chain whose head is included in the hash-protected HealthControlState. Reads, assessments and recoveries verify the complete chain; deletion, mutation, sequence/reorder, previous-hash and head mismatches fail closed. HEALTHY no-op acknowledgements still version durable evidence.

items.area: Streaming DEGRADED lifecycle and reconnect safety
items.resolution: Implemented sticky DEGRADED lifecycle for timeout, EOF, socket/protocol failure and continuity integrity failure. DEGRADED state tears down the session and refuses reconnect/advance until an explicit future recovery design exists, preventing reconnect from hiding an unresolved gap.
